title: Jacob Vider
text:
I develop scientific software, image-processing pipelines, and statistical methods for astronomy, detector instrumentation, and large-scale data analysis.
My research has included detector calibration, spectroscopy, transient astronomy, machine learning, and scientific computing through work at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, the University of Maryland, the University of Arizona, Columbia University, and the New York Genome Center.




Astronomical Instrumentation
Scientific Computing
Image Processing
Signal Processing
Statistical Inference
Machine Learning






Python pipeline for CCD calibration and detector characterization.



Algorithms for restoring astronomical imaging data.



Laboratory measurements of UV/Optical transmission filters.



Variability analysis using Lomb–Scargle periodograms and Bayesian modeling.




Currently interested in scientific software engineering, quantitative research, and astronomical instrumentation.
